text:
Your broke future started as a thought you allowed.

It's midnight. You're flat on your back, phone in your face, and your mind is running "this is just how it is."

You think that's nothing. It's not.

Every dollar, every building started as one thought. Someone fed that thought. It grew. It showed up in the real world.

The "this is how it is" story is the most expensive thought you own.

For 7 days, catch that thought when it shows up. Say its name out loud. Then feed it something better.

Your mind is already working. Aim it.
caption:
Every bad habit, every broke year started as a thought you let run wild. Mindset isn't soft. It's the engine.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
